question: At which of the following places are there no major inscriptions of Ashoka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanchi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanchi is a Buddhist complex in Madhya Pradesh, India, where Ashoka's edicts have not been found.**
 
• **Ashoka **was an Indian emperor of the **Maurya Dynasty** who ruled from **268 to 232 BCE.**
 
• He is known for his conversion to** Buddhism **and his efforts to spread the religion throughout his empire.
 
• Ashoka's edicts were inscribed on **pillars, rocks, and caves** throughout his empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Girnar** is a mountain peak in** Gujarat, India**, where Ashoka's edicts have been found.
 
• **Kandahar** is a city in** Afghanistan** that was once part of Ashoka's empire, but no edicts have been found there.
 
• **Kalsi** is a village in **Uttarakhand,** India, where Ashoka's edicts have been found.
